desc:
🛼 Welcome to +1 Speed Skate Escape! 🛼
HOW TO PLAY:
⚡ Gain +1 Speed every time you move!
🛼 Skate through stages and dodge dangerous obstacles!
💪 Train your speed and unlock powerful CHARMS!
👥 Race against friends and other players!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards and become the FASTEST on the server!
🔥 Are you fast enough to reach the finish line?
👍 LIKE the game and join the GROUP for Rewards!
